verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs include a getting-started flow with copy-paste TypeScript snippets for gating and metering (autumn.check, autumn.track). They also document the billing endpoints a payment flow needs: attach for subscriptions and upgrades, preview of charges, and a customer billing portal. Setup is supported by a CLI with pull/push config and by llms.txt. However, the evidence only shows JavaScript/TypeScript examples, the attach/checkout step has no code snippet in the pack, and no hands-on report confirms an integration done from the docs in under a day (the community quote only says the founder plans to integrate). Missing for 10: copy-paste examples in languages beyond TS/JS, a code snippet for the checkout/attach payment step, independent evidence of integration time under a day, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
